summary: Someone else is present at the desk while the official and visitor speak to each other.
realLife: Senate aide Charles Ferris recalled a Reuters reporter hearing his account of a trade bill’s prospects while Ferris talked with other reporters in the Senate gallery.
inGame: needs: identify a present non-speaker in the scene cast before referring to their presence.

turns.what: The listener waits until the visitor leaves before asking the official a question.
turns.pulledBy: The visitor was addressing the official privately about their case.
turns.writesBack: A separate conversation occurs after the visit.

turns.what: The aide hears the request at the desk and steps outside before the visitor gives an account number.
turns.pulledBy: The visitor asks for privacy before handing over the document.
turns.writesBack: The aide can confirm the subject of the visit and the caseworker alone handles the personal details.
